title: Add retry-token contract and idempotency-session for tool streams
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Long-lived streamed tool/function calls can fail transiently in places that make naive retries unsafe (partial frames, duplicated tool executions, or inconsistent state). We need a minimal, backward-compatible on-the-wire contract that lets clients express retry intent and lets servers reason about whether a retry is safe without requiring full request bodies to be replayed. This PR introduces two complementary primitives: (1) Retry-Token: an opaque, short-lived token clients attach to retry attempts to indicate a controlled replay window; (2) Idempotency-Session: a server-scoped session identifier used to sequence tool-call frames and ensure at-most-once semantics for side-effecting frames. The goal is pragmatic: improve robustness of streamed tool calls and streaming responses, while preserving OpenAI-compat adapter behavior when present.

release_notes: Adds Retry-Token header and Idempotency-Session behavior for streamed tool calls. Backwards compatible: servers accept requests without tokens and default to previous behavior; OpenAI-compat shim maps existing Idempotency-Key. Users should update SDKs to use the helper for retries to avoid duplicate side-effects. See docs/api/retry_and_idempotency.md for migration steps and examples.
review_conversation: Evan Liu: overall this looks good. A couple of safety checks: ensure session leases are bounded and cannot be abused to hold memory indefinitely. Also add metrics for session expiration and forced eviction.

Author (Maya Patel): responded: added a lease TTL with 5 minute default and a hard eviction after 1 hour; implemented metrics 'stream.idempotency_session.active' and 'stream.idempotency_session.evicted'.

Carlos Gomez: noted a potential race where two concurrent retries with different Retry-Tokens could both succeed if the initial run is slow. Suggest atomically claiming a session sequence index before executing side effects.
Author: implemented sequence claim in session_manager.go and added integration tests that simulate concurrent retries; updated docs with sequencing guidance.
Priya Menon: approved after verifying tests and SDK header helpers. Left a small docs nit which was fixed.
CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, go vet). Merge queued and completed via squash merge.
motivation_and_context: Background: we observed two classes of production incidents: (1) clients retrying after a stream ECONNRESET leading to duplicate external tool execution; (2) partial frames being repeated causing downstream consumers to misinterpret state. Prior fixes relied on best-effort client behavior and documentation. This PR provides a portable primitive that explicit clients can opt-in to and servers can use to enforce safe replay windows. It also harmonizes the OpenAI-compat layer: we map Idempotency-Key for unary calls to Idempotency-Session when appropriate, but streaming paths prefer the new headers.
compatibility_notes: OpenAI-compat: unchanged semantics for simple (non-streaming) completions that already use Idempotency-Key. For streaming endpoints the shim will accept both the legacy OpenAI header and the new X-Redwood-* headers; when both are present X-Redwood-* takes precedence. SDKs: published a minor client release with helpers. Rolling deploy: server defaults ensure no immediate behavior change for callers that do not send headers.
testing: Added unit tests for token validation and TTL eviction; end-to-end integration tests simulate: normal execution, reconnect-with-retry-token/resume, concurrent retry attempts, and failure modes (expired token, session mismatch). Test matrix run in CI included Linux amd64 and a lightweight macOS matrix for SDK tests. All tests green.
docs_updated: docs/api/retry_and_idempotency.md was added and cross-linked from the streaming docs. It contains examples, recommended TTLs, SDK snippets, and troubleshooting steps for common failure modes.
notes_for_ops: Operators can observe new metrics to tune defaults: stream.idempotency_session.active, stream.idempotency_session.evicted, stream.retry_token.invalid_count. Default lease TTL is 5m; if customers have very long-running tools they should configure session TTLs in Dedicated/Private deployments via 'streaming.session.ttl' setting.
changelog_entry: Streaming: Introduced Retry-Token and Idempotency-Session to make streamed tool calls safer to retry. (non-breaking, opt-in).
manual_steps_for_release: 1) Publish client SDK patch to registries (npm, internal). 2) Deploy server main with feature enabled behind env REDWOOD_STREAMING_IDEMPOTENCY=1. 3) Monitor new metrics for 24h and watch for unexpected evictions. 4) Announce migration guide to customers via changelog and console banner.
post_merge_followups: Follow-ups: (a) optional persistent lease backing for long-running workloads behind config flag; (b) add a diagnostic endpoint to inspect active sessions for debugging; (c) consider returning machine-readable retry advice header (x-redwood-retry-advice) in a later PR.
human_summary: This PR adds explicit retry and idempotency primitives for streamed tool/function calls to reduce duplicate side-effects and improve resume behavior. It's opt-in and backward compatible; SDKs and docs were updated. Merged via squash after approvals and green CI.
